## Action sequence — remaining moves

**No more single-edit ship-quality promotions available.** The remaining KEEP-salvageable tools (Walkthrough 14, Notes-Drill 15, Recognize 15, Claim 15, Trace 16, Predict 16, Warmup 16, Gotcha 17, Swap-Bench 17) all have deferred edits in their audits, but the lifts get smaller and most need authoring (per-lesson `whyAnswer` strings, corpus expansion) rather than engine work.

**If pursuing further:**
1. **Flash** — the only remaining IMPROVE band tool. Cross-lesson Flash stream is a fresh surface — possibly worth doing for the +2 Interleaving plus stronger mobile-fit story.
2. **Conversation removal** — user already marked REMOVE-as-standalone; could ship the settings-toggle-off-by-default per the audit removal path.
3. **Phase 6 (architectural) — recognition-tier ceiling lift.** Adding a free-text-first variant to the 7 MC-tier drills (Predict, Claim, Recognize, Trace, Reverse, Warmup, Rapid-Fire) would lift Encoding 1→2 across 7 tools. Big architectural decision; needs user input on whether to ship.

**Or just stop.** 17/28 = 61% ship-quality, only 1 IMPROVE-band tool, no REMOVE-band tools. Strong floor.

## Cross-cutting findings (refreshed)

1. **All projected lifts delivered.** The campaign's `salvage-edit math → projected rescore` predictions were accurate to within ±0 for 27/28 tools and exceeded by +3 on the Gotcha→Crux transformation. The eval-learning-tool rubric is a reliable predictor.

2. **Streak Map regression fully fixed.** The pre-Phase-3 classifier closed-set bug (heatmap silently decaying as new event types shipped) is closed: PASS_EVENTS / MISS_EVENTS sets in `08-drills-bughunt-constraint.js` now recognize all 9 event types active in the campaign-era codebase.

3. **Reflection-tool stack is now 9/10 at ship-quality.** Only Mock Replay Reel sits at 5/6 (deliberately scoped to L3 tab — see audit). Streak Map and Mistake Tagging promoted via Phase 4 close out the "all reflection tools KEEP" milestone.

4. **Recognition-tier ceiling unchanged.** Predict, Claim, Recognize, Trace, Reverse, Warmup all stayed Encoding 1/3 as expected — all MC-tier by structure. The path past 1/3 is free-text production, which is an architectural lift (Phase 6 in the original IMPROVEMENT-PLAN).

5. **Conversation tab is the only remaining "demote vs keep" decision.** User marked it REMOVE-as-standalone after the route-to-convDrill demoted it. Pure-read tab with a banner pointing to the recall drill. If you want zero IMPROVE-band tools, ship the settings-toggle-off path; otherwise the route makes it tolerable.
